body:
This creature resembles a massive tyrannosaurus constructed entirely of wood and leaves and other vegetable matter. Its entire body is covered with small, thorny spikes.

CR 17

XP 102,400
N Colossal plant
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +39

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 3, flat-footed 22 (+1 Dex, +20 natural, –8 size)
hp 357 (34d8+204)
Fort +25; Ref +14; Will +15
Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +33 (6d6+30/19–20)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks swallow whole (3d8+15 acid damage, AC 20, 35 hp), thorns

STATISTICS

Str 40, Dex 13, Con 23, Int 2, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +25; CMB +48 (+52 grapple); CMD 59
Feats Bleeding Critical, Critical Focus, Critical Mastery, Diehard, Endurance, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Run, Skill Focus (Perception), Staggering Critical, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Perception +39, Stealth +6 (+14 in swamps or forests); Racial Modifiers +8 Perception, +4 Stealth (+12 in swamps or forests)
SQ powerful bite

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Thorns (Ex)

2d8+15 damage

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3–6)
Treasure none
